scripts.spec:pull: curl -fsS "${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8080}/api-docs/public" -o openapi/public.json && curl -fsS "${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:8080}/api-docs/admin" -o openapi/admin.json && node -e "for(const f of ['openapi/public.json','openapi/admin.json']){const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')),null,2)+'\n')}"
scripts.gen:api: openapi-typescript openapi/public.json -o src/lib/api/schema.public.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/admin.json -o src/lib/api/schema.admin.ts
scripts.gen:api:check: pnpm gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/api/schema.public.ts src/lib/api/schema.admin.ts
